scope: Independent read-only review of LightGBM continuation, submission continuation and frozen-ensemble comparison. No source-code edits or real-data fitting.
conclusion: No material counting, checkpoint retention, default-path or current-cohort alignment bug found for the configured deterministic LightGBM continuation.

implementation_findings.total_vs_additional_rounds: prepare_continuation treats config n_estimators as TOTAL and passes total-initial.current_iteration() additional rounds. Installed LightGBM engine loops from init_iteration to init_iteration+num_boost_round, confirming this interpretation.
implementation_findings.best_iteration_count: Installed LightGBM train sets best_iteration from the callback and serializes/reloads with model_to_string() before returning, truncating to selected best trees. current_iteration therefore matches saved tree count in this path.
implementation_findings.source_retention: Initial Booster is independently loaded, continuation produces a new Booster, and the initial predictions/model are retained when continued standalone validation AUC does not exceed source AUC.
implementation_findings.full_fit: Full fit continues a model from the identical all-label cohort; config validation boundaries cannot match a historical-fold source, and a selected-total-rounds assertion ensures requested total is reached.
implementation_findings.defaults: No init_model yields copied unchanged estimator parameters and None provenance. Passing init_model=None and recording evaluation history do not change the fitting algorithm.
implementation_findings.feature_provenance: All use_* options, feature names/order and all model settings except total cap are checked; binary-only source objective is enforced.
implementation_findings.cohort_provenance: Split dates, training count, end/start dates where available and stored ordered case hash where available are verified. Source 2021 legacy report lacks full cohort hash; source AUC reproduction and preserved original data add evidence.
implementation_findings.source_identity: Expected model path is tied to the source report stem or its recorded model_path; source model/report SHA256 values are captured. Relevant original models/data/metric/topology still match the goal-start hash manifest.
implementation_findings.comparison: Original plant weights are fixed. Prediction IDs/order and all2352columns are checked before arithmetic. Baseline AUC must reproduce the previous winning historical report.
implementation_findings.jan7_subset: Last2021case starts Dec31 and ends Jan7 exclusive; excluding Jan1-Jan6 starts gives359cases. Baseline and candidate metrics use the same mask. Independent recomputation matches.

independent_tiny_checks.note: Small synthetic functional test only; no real project model fit.

frozen_comparison_independently_recomput.interpretation: The older frozen ensemble retains strong overall discrimination but loses about0.002AUC on2022 relative to models fitted through2021. The loss persists after excluding selection-horizon overlap. Training recency/size, selected iteration counts and distribution shift change together, so this is not an isolated overfitting measurement.
frozen_comparison_independently_recomput.neural_context: Tokke remains near the current ensemble; the standalone frozen Transformer decline is partly concentrated in generators where its final blend weight is zero.
frozen_comparison_independently_recomput.candidate_mean_caveat: Only candidate_replace is entirely the frozen2021 model set. candidate_mean includes2022-trained/selected reference models and must not be described as fully frozen forward validation.

limitations_and_nonblocking_observations: Continuation restarts early-stopping patience. The selected initial model is retained, but training trajectory is not guaranteed to stop at the same epoch as one uninterrupted run.
Current real configs use deterministic mode with no bagging/feature subsampling. Tiny equivalence evidence should not be generalized to every future stochastic LightGBM configuration.

Legacy source reports lack a full input-matrix fingerprint and ordered-cohort hash. Feature identity, split metadata, original-file preservation and source-score reproduction are strong current checks, but not a universal proof against arbitrary feature-builder changes.

Retention/selection uses standalone LightGBM AUC, so an alternative checkpoint with slightly lower standalone AUC but better ensemble contribution may be discarded. This is a selection-policy limitation, not a continuation implementation bug.
The Jan7 subset removes horizon overlap with2021 selection cases; it does not make2022 untouched. Both years have been heavily reused for model development.
